meta.goal: Convert the platform from a strong prototype into a production-ready monitoring system through staged, prioritized hardening work.

sprints.name: Stabilize runtime and security foundations
sprints.goal: Reduce incidents caused by session lifecycle, auth gaps, and unprotected API traffic.

items.title: Add request correlation IDs and security headers in web middleware
items.description: Inject request IDs and standard security headers for safer HTTP behavior and easier operational debugging.

items.title: Hardening for API credentials and session access controls
items.description: Validate internal service auth, allowlist trusted origins, and review admin endpoints and privilege boundaries.

items.title: Add idempotency and duplicate event protection
items.description: Ensure duplicate event deliveries cannot create duplicate task records or inconsistent state.

items.title: Improve stream-health and degraded-state detection
items.description: Track stale frames, dropped streams, frame loss, and degraded detection conditions before they create silent bad events.

sprints.name: Data integrity and auditability
sprints.goal: Make task history trustworthy and explainable under production conditions.

items.title: Add DB-level constraints and indexes for audit-safe data
items.description: Enforce valid statuses, time ordering, and performant queries for session and task history.

items.title: Create immutable audit event records for overrides and state changes
items.description: Track every override and critical system decision in a tamper-resistant, reconstructable audit trail.

items.title: Version event payload contracts and centralize validation
items.description: Use typed contracts and versioned payloads so inference and web app expectations stay aligned.

sprints.name: ML quality and validation
sprints.goal: Reduce false positives/negatives and make quality measurable over time.

items.title: Create a labeled validation benchmark for production conditions
items.description: Capture a representative dataset for task classification and detection performance under real farm conditions.

items.title: Replace brittle threshold logic with validated confidence policies
items.description: Make task detection and missed-task handling depend on calibrated confidence bands and time windows.

items.title: Add drift and model-health dashboards
items.description: Track model and task drift, detection distribution, and confidence degradation.

sprints.name: Operational monitoring and alerting
sprints.goal: Give operators the telemetry and alerts needed to run the system safely in production.

items.title: Add structured logs and tracing with correlation IDs
items.description: Trace session flows across HTTP requests, inference events, and persistence layers.

items.title: Set up alerting for stream loss, DB outage, and abnormal detection behavior
items.description: Create operational runbooks and alerting policies for failures that affect compliance outcomes.

items.title: Create production health dashboards for services and sessions
items.description: Expose service health, queue depth, session state, and detection quality to operators.

sprints.name: Release readiness and deployment hardening
sprints.goal: Make the platform deployable and safe under repeatable release practices.

items.title: Create production deployment architecture and environment separation
items.description: Move deployment from local dev assumptions to a production-safe environment model.

items.title: Add CI quality gates and smoke tests before production release
items.description: Ensure build, typecheck, integration tests, and contract checks are mandatory before release.

items.title: Finalize documentation, ADRs, and operator runbooks
items.description: Document production ownership, release process, rollback steps, and operational procedures.
